methods.title: How you sign in
methods.description: You can use any of these to get back into your account.
methods.phoneMissing: Not added. Add one to sign in with a text-message code.
methods.emailMissing: Not added. Add one for receipts and to sign in with a password.
methods.googleMissing: Not connected. Sign in with Google using this email to connect it.
methods.passwordGoogle: Not set. You sign in with Google.
methods.passwordCode: Not set. You sign in with a code.

password.changed: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.
password.set: Password set. You can now sign in with it.
password.changeDescription: You'll stay signed in here; your other devices will be signed out.
password.setDescription: Add a password so you can also sign in with your email.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Removes your details, addresses, wishlist and Bag, and signs you out everywhere.
delete.kept: For the shop's records, orders you have placed are kept with the name, address, phone and email used for them. Nobody can sign in to the account again, and your reviews stay without your name. This can't be undone.
delete.confirmDescription: This can't be undone. Type {identifier} to confirm.

security.title: Security activity
security.description: What happened on your account lately. If something looks unfamiliar, sign out the device and change your password.
security.label: Security activity

event.new_device: Signed in from a new device

devices.title: Your devices
devices.description: Where you're signed in. Sign out any you don't recognise.
devices.label: Devices

address.phoneHint: 8 digits. The courier will call this number.

addresses.noneHint: Save one to check out faster.
addresses.label: Saved addresses
addresses.deleteDescription: {name}, {line}. Past orders keep their own copy.

contact.sendToPhone: We'll send a 6-digit code to the new phone number to make sure it's yours.
contact.sendToEmail: We'll send a 6-digit code to the new email address to make sure it's yours.
contact.removeDescription: You won't be able to sign in with {destination} any more.
contact.removePasswordToo: Your password is removed with it.

wishlist.signIn: Sign in to save items to your wishlist.
wishlist.emptyHint: Tap the heart on any product to keep it here.

reauth.label: Confirmation code
reauth.hint: We'll send a code to {destination} to check it's you.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor sign-in
twoFactor.description: Signing in also needs a code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.requiredBody: Add this protection to your account before using the back office.
twoFactor.scan: Scan the QR code with Google Authenticator, 1Password or a similar app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code to scan with an authenticator app
twoFactor.manual: Can't scan it? Type this key instead:
twoFactor.recoveryHelp: Keep these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your phone. They won't be shown again.
twoFactor.lost: If you lose both your phone and the codes, a server administrator can reset this.
